D: A heartbroken 1985 wedding singer falls for a waitress who's about to marry the wrong guy.
P: Serve the mains when Grandma Rosie hands Robbie her meatballs.
S: Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips and baked
Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips, egg washed and baked at 200C for 15 minutes, with mustard and tomato sauce.
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled in walnuts, with crackers
Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled into a ball, coated in chopped walnuts, served with crackers.
Peanut brittle, first class, with Billy Idol aboard.

Salted roasted peanuts set in a golden honey toffee with a little butter and bicarb so it shatters, broken into shards and bagged like airline snacks. Line a tray with baking paper. Heat 200g caster sugar, 60ml honey and 60ml water in a saucepan, stirring until dissolved, then boil without stirring until light golden, about 8 minutes. Stir in 200g salted roasted peanuts and 20g butter and cook 1 to 2 minutes more until amber. Take off the heat, stir in half a teaspoon bicarb and pour onto the tray. Cool 30 minutes, then smash into shards and bag up.
M: Rosie pays Robbie in meatballs. Beef and pork, parmesan, tomato.
Beef and pork meatballs with parmesan, parsley and breadcrumbs, browned and simmered 40 minutes in tomato sauce, over spaghetti.
Reception stuffed chicken and lemon butter

Chicken breasts stuffed with spinach and ricotta, roasted at 200C for 20 minutes, with roast potatoes and beans. Mix 200g ricotta with 60g chopped baby spinach, 30g grated parmesan, lemon zest and pepper. Cut a pocket into the side of 4 chicken breasts and stuff. Sear in oil 3 minutes a side, then roast at 200C for 20 minutes. Roast 800g halved chat potatoes in oil at 200C for 40 minutes. Steam 2 bunches green beans. Melt 60g butter with the juice of 1 lemon and parsley and spoon over the sliced chicken.
W: Butter sponge layers with strawberry jam, iced white with buttercream

Two vanilla butter sponges sandwiched with strawberry jam, iced white with vanilla buttercream and scattered with silver cachous. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Sandwich with strawberry jam, ice white with buttercream and scatter silver cachous over the top.
K: Grow Old With You pineapple punch
Pineapple, orange juice and lemonade punch with scoops of lime sherbet floating on top

Pineapple and orange juice topped with lemonade in a big bowl, scoops of lime sherbet floating and fizzing on top, with orange slices. Chill everything well. Pour 1L pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big punch bowl. Just before serving, top with 1.25L cold lemonade and add 1 sliced orange. Float 6 scoops of lime or orange sherbet on top so they foam as they melt. Ladle into cups with a bit of sherbet in each.

s.note: Cocktail franks wrapped in puff pastry strips and baked
s.how: Simmer 24 cocktail franks for 3 minutes and drain. Cut puff pastry into strips and roll one around each frank. Brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden. Serve with mustard and tomato sauce at the reception.

s.note: Cheddar, cream cheese and spring onion rolled in walnuts, with crackers
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and sliced spring onion. Shape into one big ball, roll in chopped walnuts and chill for an hour. Serve with crackers on a doily, eighties party style.

m.note: Rosie pays Robbie in meatballs. Beef and pork, parmesan, tomato.
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince, 300g pork mince, grated parmesan, chopped parsley, breadcrumbs and an egg. Roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer 40 minutes. Serve over 500g spaghetti, the way Grandma Rosie pays for lessons.
